title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.168.0
author: Asha Patel
body: Motivation: Bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to parity for auth, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics and prepare a coordinated version bump to v1.168.0. This PR consolidates prior per-language fixes into a single unified change set so developers have consistent behavior across platforms. What changed: 1) Auth: standardized token refresh hook signature and added transparent retry-on-auth-failure behavior with exponential backoff (max 3 retries) to match design doc ENG-4521. 2) Retries: unified transient error classification and retry decorators across SDKs, introduced idempotency hint support for safe retries, and exposed retry policy configuration in client constructors. 3) Streaming ergonomics: improved client streaming iterator behavior to yield partial chunks immediately, added explicit close/drain helpers, and fixed backpressure handling in the TS SDK to align with Python/Go. 4) Parity fixes: harmonized error classes and response metadata fields (request_id, server_trace) so parsing and on_error hooks behave the same cross-language. 5) Version bumps: Python->v1.168.0, TS->v1.168.0, Go->v1.168.0 and updated changelogs. Migration notes: - Applications relying on previous streaming iterators should call client.stream.close() or await client.stream.drain() on shutdown to ensure KV cache flush; examples updated. - Retry default changed from 2 to 3 attempts for auth failures; pass max_retries to client to revert. - Auth hook signature changed from (token) to (token, context) for future extensibility; adapters provided. Testing and CI: full unit, integration tests, and interop smoke tests added. All checks passed after flapping lint failure was fixed (TS linter rule for async iterators). Checklist: - [x] Add cross-SDK tests - [x] Update changelogs and docs - [x] Add migration notes - [x] Run release smoke tests - [x] Bump versions This is ready to merge as a squash merge to preserve clear history for the version bump.
commits: Add streaming ergonomics helpers and TS backpressure fix
Unify error classes and metadata fields
Add interop tests and update changelogs
Fix lint failures and CI flakiness
review_comments: Marcus Lee: LGTM overall, left a minor comment around the idempotency hint naming in the Go client.
Asha Patel (author): Addressed Marcus comment and renamed IdempotencyHint -> IdempotencyKey in Go; added unit tests.
Sofia Nguyen: Can you add an explicit example for graceful shutdown in Python docs? The streaming changes are great but users will need a clear migration path.
Asha Patel (author): Added docs/sdks/migration-v1.168.0.md with graceful shutdown examples for Python/TS/Go.
Diego Ramirez: CI flaky on integration runtime test in first run due to env variable race; re-run fixed it. Approving now.
release_notes: - SDKs: unify auth token refresh + retry semantics across Python/TS/Go. - Streaming: improved ergonomics and backpressure handling; added close/drain helpers. - Parity: harmonized error classes and response metadata. - Version bump to v1.168.0 for Python/TS/Go. Migration: see docs/sdks/migration-v1.168.0.md for shutdown examples and auth hook changes.
